tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, player cards, sheets, bottom nav.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Board cells, inputs, chips, pressed rows; sits on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card hairlines only. Not for control borders (below 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, board grid lines, secondary button outline. At least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, inactive tab labels on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Purple as text or line: links, active tab, selected outline, rating numbers on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.usage: Purple fill of primary buttons, the Play hero and progress bars. Carries on-primary text.

tokens.name: primary-shade
tokens.usage: The 4px 3D ledge under primary-fill buttons and the hero card.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-fill, alert-fill and tier fills.

tokens.name: piece-x
tokens.usage: X marks, X player's clock ring and the winning line when X wins. Cyan, told apart from O by hue and lightness and always by glyph.

tokens.name: piece-o
tokens.usage: O marks, O player's clock ring and the winning line when O wins.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Sudden-death text, clock digits at 3s or less, error messages on bg and surface.

tokens.name: alert-fill
tokens.usage: Red-alert clock pill, the impact-frame flash, the Resign confirm button. Carries on-primary.

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: Streak flame, daily quest rewards and the dark-theme focus ring.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Rating gains (+12), completed quests, 'Your move' indicator. Always paired with a sign or check glyph.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset on every focusable control.

tokens.name: tier-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze tier badge fill and rank text.

tokens.name: tier-silver
tokens.usage: Silver tier badge fill and rank text.

tokens.name: tier-gold
tokens.usage: Gold tier badge fill and rank text.

tokens.name: tier-platinum
tokens.usage: Platinum tier badge fill and rank text.

tokens.name: tier-diamond
tokens.usage: Diamond tier badge fill and rank text.

tokens.name: tier-master
tokens.usage: Master tier badge fill and rank text. Master is the only tier with seasonal resets.

families.headline: "Luckiest Guy", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: Fredoka, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Big headline moments only: Play, VICTORY/DEFEAT, SUDDEN DEATH, logo. Letters bounce (BounceText).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the Play hero.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your oldest piece vanishes next turn.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase button labels, tab labels, chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between board cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Player card padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around the board in the match screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, board cells on small boards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, board cells, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the board frame, the Play hero, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Clock pill, streak pill, avatars.

tokens.name: ledge-primary
tokens.usage: 3D ledge under primary buttons; collapses to 0 on press while the button moves down 4px.

tokens.name: ledge-neutral
tokens.usage: 3D ledge under secondary buttons, board cells and cards you can tap.

tokens.name: glow-alert
tokens.usage: Pulsing glow on the clock pill in sudden death.
